capabilities: search IGDB for games and create a note from a single import
queue multiple games and bulk-import them at once
fill custom Markdown templates with {{variable}} game metadata
resolve naming conflicts when a game note already exists
pull cover images, ratings, screenshots, and similar games into notes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; setup requires registering an application in the Twitch Developer Console.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search video game databases and turn the results into structured notes, so game catalogs must be created by hand.

relations.evidence: This is inspired by the Obsidian plugin Book Search.
pull video game metadata from the IGDB (Internet Game Database) API

requires.name: IGDB API credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from the Twitch Developer Console)

summary: Game metadata importer that searches the IGDB API and generates formatted game notes from custom Markdown templates.
